items.name: Whoosh_Light
items.description: Air moved by a jab or cross. Short, dry, no tail. The sound of missing.

items.name: Whoosh_Heavy
items.description: A hook, kick or knee cutting air. Lower and longer than the light one; the wind-up should be audible.

items.name: Hit_Light
items.description: Fist on body, jab or cross. A slap with weight behind it, not a movie punch. Dry.

items.name: Hit_Heavy
items.description: Hook, kick or knee landing. Deep, with a crack on top. This is the one the player waits for.

items.name: Hit_Knockdown
items.description: The blow that puts someone down. Heavier than Hit_Heavy and followed by the body hitting the ground.

items.name: Block
items.description: A strike caught on the forearms. Dull thud, muffled, no crack.

items.name: Parry
items.description: The perfect guard. Sharp and bright with a short ring -- it has to be unmistakable from Block, because it is the reward.

items.name: Rage
items.description: The finisher going off. Big, low, room-filling; the one sound allowed to be cinematic.

items.name: Hawk_Ignite
items.description: HAWK FIST lighting up: a whump of flame catching on a fist.

items.name: Hawk_Hit
items.description: A flaming punch landing. Hit_Heavy with a burst of fire over it.

items.name: KO
items.description: A fighter going down for good. Body on ground, then nothing. Not a crowd sound.

items.name: Boss_Enrage
items.description: A boss crossing into phase two. A roar, or a breath drawn -- it should make the player step back.

items.name: Dash
items.description: A dodge dash. Feet scraping and a short rush of cloth.

items.name: Dash_Leap
items.description: The dash once DASH LEAP is held: the same scrape, then a beat of nothing before the landing.

items.name: Footstep
items.description: One step on the stage floor. Fired from the walk animation's notify. Wide pitch range so a walk cycle never sounds looped.

items.name: Land
items.description: Feet hitting the ground after a leap or a knockback.

items.name: Gate_Strike
items.description: A strike landing on a shutter or a cracked wall that has not given yet. Metal or stone taking a hit and holding.

items.name: Gate_Break
items.description: The third strike: a shutter tearing off its rails, or masonry coming down. Debris after.

items.name: Gate_Open
items.description: A ledge climbed, a gap crossed, a locker opened -- the quiet gates. A latch, a scrape, a hand on stone.

items.name: Talent_Found
items.description: A talent picked up. The biggest UI sound in the game; the world just opened.

items.name: Exp_Cache
items.description: XP found behind a gate. Smaller than Talent_Found; a reward, not a milestone.

items.name: Exit_Travel
items.description: Walking out of an area into the next. A door, a step through, a breath of the new place.

items.name: Exit_Sealed
items.description: A route refusing you. Solid and final -- a bolt, a hand on a locked door. Pairs with the SEALED banner.

items.name: Wave_Start
items.description: An ambush closing in. Low, rising, short. The arena just locked.

items.name: Wave_Clear
items.description: The last of a wave down and the arena unlocking. A release, not a fanfare.

items.name: Stage_Clear
items.description: An area beaten. This one can be a fanfare.

items.name: Stage_Fail
items.description: Ahmed down. Low and slow; no sting.

items.name: Level_Up
items.description: A rank gained from fighting. Bright, short, upward.

items.name: Upgrade_Bought
items.description: XP spent at the training camp. A confirm with weight; money changing hands.

items.name: UI_Tap
items.description: Any button. Quiet, dry, instant.

items.name: UI_Back
items.description: Going back a screen. UI_Tap, lower.

items.name: UI_Denied
items.description: A button that will not: not enough XP, a locked mode. Short, flat, not rude.

items.name: Weapon_Pickup
items.description: A pipe, plank or crowbar picked up out of a smashed crate.

items.name: Weapon_Swing
items.description: An armed punch cutting air. Heavier than Whoosh_Heavy and with the object's own sound: pipe ring, plank whip.

items.name: Weapon_Hit
items.description: An armed punch landing. Steel or wood on body.

items.name: Weapon_Break
items.description: The last use spent: the plank splitting, the pipe clanging away.

items.name: Crate_Break
items.description: A crate or barrel giving way. Wood splintering, or a barrel's hollow clang.

items.name: Pickup_Health
items.description: The skewer. Warm, quick.

items.name: Pickup_Rage
items.description: The rage orb. A charge taken in; a little electric.

items.name: Music_Stage
items.description: The fight loop. One track per theme is the intent; start with one and cast per stage later.

items.name: Music_Menu
items.description: The title screen. Slower than the fight loop, same key.

items.name: Music_Boss
items.description: The title fights -- ZAYOS in the cellar

items.name: Music_Under
items.description: Underground. The stage loop slowed and sunk: sub bass, a darbuka echoing in a cellar, no top end.

items.name: Music_Up
items.description: The roofs. The stage loop opened out: wind, wide reverb, oud and qanun high above the street.
